g_1.summary: Fast-paced 1v1 air hockey matches. First to 5 goals wins.
g_1.rules: Standard air hockey rules. Serve alternates after each goal.

g_2.summary: Table football tournament. Teams compete in knockout format.
g_2.rules: 5 goals to win. No spinning. Serve from center after each goal.

g_3.summary: Indoor bowls competition. Precision rolling to get closest to the jack.
g_3.rules: Each player rolls 2 bowls per end. 6 ends per match. Closest bowl to jack scores 1 point.

g_4.summary: Ten pin bowling. Highest total score across multiple frames wins.
g_4.rules: Standard ten pin scoring. Players have 2 throws per round. Total pinfall determines ranking.

g_5.summary: Darts competition. Players aim for the highest score across multiple rounds.
g_5.rules: Each player throws 3 darts per turn over multiple rounds, aiming for maximum points each time. The team with the most points at the end wins.

g_6.summary: Canadian Whist tournament. Groups are formed with one member from each team.
g_6.rules: Each group plays rounds of Canadian Whist. The player with the most points at the end wins that group's game.
